chunks: Muḥammad al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who became junub in his garment and had no garment with him other than it.
He said: “He prays in it, and when he finds water, he washes it.”

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ: became junub, entering the state of janabah

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he becomes junub in his garment and has no other clothes to pray in?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one whose garment has become affected by janabah and who has no other clothing available. He should perform salat (prayer) in that garment, and when water becomes available, he should wash it.
